hero.title: About
hero.subtitle: 3rd year B.Tech IT + MBA at IIIT Gwalior. Full stack developer, currently interning at QuickIntell.

aboutSections.title: Who I Am
content: I'm Nishant Harkut, a 3rd year dual-degree student (B.Tech IT + MBA) at IIIT Gwalior. I got into tech through design — spent my first year learning UI/UX and graphic design, won a few college design competitions, and did a design internship. That background shaped how I think about building things, but I knew I wanted to go deeper than mockups.

aboutSections.title: Design to Dev
content: After first year, I went all-in on development. I started building full-stack projects — a Web3 collaboration platform, an AI travel planner, a career coaching SaaS — and competing in hackathons. That led to a top-10 finish at ODOO India Hackathon (out of 10,000+ teams) and a first-place win at Hacknovate 6.0.

Right now I'm interning at QuickIntell as a Software Engineer, working on OCR pipelines, backend services, and AI integrations for their healthcare RCM product. My stack is mostly React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, and PostgreSQL, with some Three.js and GSAP when a project calls for it.

aboutSections.title: Security Awareness
content: I've been picking up web application security alongside development — OWASP fundamentals, auth implementations, API security patterns. It's not my primary focus, but I think building things without understanding how they break is a gap worth closing.

aboutSections.title: Beyond Code
content: Outside of coding, I play basketball, go to the gym, and mess around with AI music generation. I'm also into graphic design, photography, and the occasional BGMI session.
